title: 第2章 昔日队友太冒昧新队友来救场了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    此人身高大概一米九，穿一身黑色作战服。

    这种衣服，秦夙在白塔里也见过，看着就比军礼服更方便行动。

    应该属于哨兵日常着装吧。

    再看这男的，长一头棕色微卷的头发，脸上笑嘻嘻的不太正经。

    刚见面他就低头凑近了些，“嗨~”

    该死的气泡音！

    秦夙急忙战术后仰，不然他下巴都要抵她头顶上了！

    “嗯？”男人直起身子捏起下巴沉思，“真的一点记忆都没有？”

    秦夙往后退一步，“你是谁啊？”

    “尤来亚小队的人啊。”男人两手一摊，“连我名字都忘了？我是诺亚，之前在队里，你跟我关系最好了啊~”

    尤来亚小队？

    就是档案中心那群人口中提到的，萧岑生前在编的那支队伍？

    奇怪，真是如此的话，诺亚为什么还管她叫萧岑？

    他应该很清楚，萧岑已经死了，现在这副身体里住着的，并不是他熟悉的人。

    见秦夙流露出警惕的神色。

    诺亚“哎哟”一声，扒开自己的领子，“我在那次任务之后，还没接受疏导呢，精神污染对我造成了影响，你看，鳞片都长出来了。”

    诺亚脖颈深处，确实出现了一层细密的，如同棕色蝮蛇般的鳞片。

    他趁秦夙好奇的查看他皮肤上异变的时机，上前来一把抓住她的手腕。

    “走吧，带我去你宿舍，给我做疏导。”

    “我……我不会啊！”秦夙本能挣扎起来，“而且我已经不是尤来亚小队的人了，我现在是离颂小队的向导，就算要做疏导，你也不该找我吧！”

    “离颂？那家伙把他队伍里的战斗向导丢给我们，她只会来硬的，一点都不甜。”诺亚越说越有点不耐烦，手上动作也愈发粗鲁，“我还是喜欢你这种治愈型向导，又温柔，又甜美，对我言听计从多可爱啊，所以还是你来给我做吧！”

    秦夙迅速提取关键信息。

    离颂原来队里的向导，是个战斗型的，在萧岑死后，他将该向导弄去了尤来亚的队伍里。

    战斗型向导可能是用某些强硬的手段帮哨兵解决身体异变问题的。

    而萧岑曾经是个非常温柔无害，逆来顺受的软糯治愈型向导，更符合诺亚的喜好。

    但这个诺亚，说的是什么混账话！

    他喜欢就行了吗？哨向难道不应该服从白塔的分配？诺亚可以不守规矩任性妄为的吗？！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This person is about 1.9 meters tall and wears a black combat uniform.

Qin Su had seen this kind of clothes in the White Tower, and they looked more convenient for movement than military uniforms.

It should be part of the daily attire of the sentry.

​Looking at this man again, he has slightly curly brown hair and an unserious smile on his face.

As soon as they met, he lowered his head and came closer, "Hi~"

Damn bubbles!

Qin Su hurriedly leaned back, otherwise his chin would be on top of her head!

"Huh?" The man straightened up and held his chin in thought, "Do you really have no memory at all?"

Qin Su took a step back and asked, "Who are you?"

"You're from the Uriah team." The man spread his hands, "You even forgot my name? I'm Noah. I was in the team before. You and I have the best relationship~"

Team Urea?

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ away out, is the team that Xiao Cen was building as mentioned by the group in the archives center?

"Strange, if that's the case, why does Noah still call her Xiao Cen?"

He should know very well that Xiao Cen is dead, and the person living in this body is not someone he is familiar with.

Seeing Qin Su showing a vigilant look.

Noah said "ouch" and took off his collar, "I haven't received any counseling after that mission. The mental pollution has affected me. You see, the scales have grown out."

Deep in Noah’s neck, a layer of fine, brown viper-like scales did appear.

He took advantage of Qin Su's curious inspection of the changes on his skin and stepped forward to grab her wrist.

"Come on, take me to your dormitory and give me some guidance."

"I...I don't know how!" Qin Su struggled instinctively, "And I am no longer a member of the Ulea team. I am now the guide of the Lisong team. Even if you want to provide guidance, you shouldn't come to me!"

"Lisong? That guy left the combat guide in his team to us. She can only do hard things, not sweet at all." The more Noah talked, the more impatient he became, and his hand movements became rougher. "I still like a healing guide like you, gentle and sweet. It's so cute to obey my words, so you better do it for me!"

Qin Su quickly extracted key information.

Li Song’s original team’s guide was a fighting type. After Xiao Cen’s death, he moved the guide to Yulea’s team.

The combat guide may use some tough methods to help the sentry solve the problem of physical mutation.

And Xiao Cen used to be a very gentle, harmless, soft and submissive healing guide, which was more in line with Noah's preferences.

But what the hell is Noah saying?

Is it okay if he likes it?Shouldn't the whistle direction obey the White Tower's assignment?Can Noah be unruly and do whatever he wants?!

title_en: Chapter 2: Former teammates were too presumptuous and new teammates came to the rescue - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"
